newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures untraded in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures untraded in quiet market.

text.p: Rubber futures were mostly untraded on Thursday in slow trade with some interest again noted for RSS3 grade rubber but little else for other rubber brands, dealers said.

"It's an empty market and there were no trades done again this morning. We'll probably see the same pattern repeat itself in the afternoon where covering will emerge for RSS3 rubber," a dealer for a commodity house said.
Lower prices in Japan prompted players in the local exchange to mark their prices lower, traders said.
Tokyo's benchmark August contract fell 1.7 yen to 154.6 while Kobe's August contract dipped 1.6 yen to 154.7 in late morning trade.
At around 0445 GMT, May RSS3 was seen at 122.00-124.00 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 123.25 cents.
May RSS1 was indicated at 175.50 Singapore cents (US$1.22) a kg from 176.00 cents.
May TSR20 was indicated at 167.75 Singapore cents (US$1.17) a kg from the previous 168.00 cents.
